Help/Getting started/Install and sign in

Install the app and sign in

You sign in with a link sent to your email. There is no password, and the first link also creates your account.

  1. Install Veylet Capture on your Pro iPhone or iPad, from the App Store or the invitation link Veylet sent you.
  2. Open it. You can read how it works and do the practice room before you sign in.
  3. When asked, enter your email address. Use the same email you use for your Veylet account on the website.
  4. Open the email on the same iPhone and tap the link. You come back to the app, signed in.

If it doesn’t work

No email after a minute? Check your junk folder, then send it again from the app.

If the link opens somewhere other than the app, go back to the app and choose Continue in browser to sign in there instead.

Sign-in links work once. If one has already been used, send a new one.

Still stuck? Email Veylet support

Write to yoda@yodalai.xyz and a person replies. Say which step you were on, your iPhone or iPad model, and the app version from Account, then About. Never send passwords or sign-in links.
